ev.q: After increasing from 2000 to 2018, age-adjusted suicide rates for non-Hispanic White males and females declined from 2018 to 2020
Age-adjusted suicide rates are per 100,000 standard population.
Rates for all races and ethnic groups were higher for males than for females throughout the period.
Source: National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data.

methods_quotes.q: Age-adjusted suicide rates are per 100,000 standard population.
Rates for 2018–2020 were based on the 1997 Office of Management and Budget standards and might differ slightly compared with the 1977 standards.
